about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: Learn · Heal · Grow — a student-founded initiative creating real conditions for every child to thrive.
about.whoWeAreSubtitle: Officially established as a student club at Balboa Academy in Panama.
about.p1: Heartitude is a student-founded initiative, officially established as a club at Balboa Academy in Panama. We work to ensure every child has the conditions to learn, heal, and grow — regardless of health status or socioeconomic background.
about.p2: What started as hands-on volunteering with pediatric cardiac patients at Fundación Latidos grew into a structured initiative spanning education, patient support, and environmental research — built and run entirely by students.
about.storySubtitle: From bedside volunteering in hospital wards to student-engineered tools and community support.
about.founderP1: In late 2024, I started volunteering with Fundación Latidos, an organization supporting pediatric cardiac patients in Panama.
about.founderP2: What I found wasn't a grand social cause — it was very specific, everyday problems. Children spending weeks in hospital wards were falling behind on basic schoolwork. Teachers in local schools lacked Spanish-language digital math resources. And at Latidos, medical and social records for hundreds of young patients were still tracked in paper binders.
about.founderP3: I realized that simply showing up for scheduled volunteer hours wasn't solving these gaps. Along with fellow students at Balboa Academy, we decided to build practical tools ourselves: weekly math and English tutoring sessions, a digitized patient registry for Latidos, and an open digital learning platform.
about.founderP4: That effort officially became Heartitude. We are not an NGO or medical professionals — we are high school students using our time, technical skills, and consistency to support children who need a fair chance to learn, heal, and grow.
about.missionDesc: Creating the educational, health, and environmental conditions every child in Panama needs to learn, heal, and grow.
about.visionDesc: A society where illness or socioeconomic barriers never dictate a child's starting line.
about.mvSubtitle: What drives our daily commitment and the long-term future we are actively building.
about.journeySubtitle: From a single question to a working organization — in one year.
about.numbersSubtitle: Measurable impact, built week by week.
about.partnersSubtitle: Organizations we work alongside — not for, but with.
about.partnerLatidosDesc: A cardiac care foundation supporting pediatric heart patients in Panama. Heartitude provides weekly bedside tutoring, developed their digital patient management platform (717+ records), and raises funds for medical supplies.
about.partnerFGLGDesc: A foundation dedicated to education and community development. Heartitude partnered with FGLG to deliver a 4-week English tutoring program serving 25 public school students across 12 structured modules.
about.partnerBalboaDesc: The school where Heartitude was founded as a student club, providing the institutional base and student volunteer network that powers our programs.

programs.introDesc: We believe education cannot be separated from well-being and environment. Our three programs work in harmony to address the root obstacles holding children back.

learn.title: Learn: Bridging Educational Disparities
learn.subtitle: Accessible math & English tutoring, national curriculum alignment, and interactive learning tools.
learn.desc: Many children miss critical school milestones due to financial hardship or long-term hospital stays. We deliver steady academic support that builds confidence and mastery.

features.title: Math Tutoring at Fundación Latidos
features.desc: Weekly 1:1 math tutoring visits for pediatric cardiac patients in Panama City. We bring tailored worksheets, manipulatives, and warm encouragement.

features.title: English Tutoring with Fundación Gabriel Lewis Galindo
features.desc: A 4-week intensive English conversation program serving 25 public school students, covering 12 practical modules from daily routines to future aspirations.

features.title: Panama National Curriculum Math Platform
features.desc: An interactive digital math system with 35 standardized units and printable workbooks, distributed to 30+ teachers, 20+ schools, and 20+ NGOs nationwide.

heal.title: Heal: Standing Beside Children in Hospitals
heal.subtitle: Bedside emotional care, patient management technology, and community fundraising for pediatric cardiac care.
heal.desc: Children facing severe cardiac conditions require more than medical treatment — they need emotional warmth, human connection, and systems that protect their continuity of care. We partner with Fundación Latidos to deliver all three.

features.title: Hospital Companionship & Face Painting
features.desc: Regular volunteer sessions at hospital wards and care spaces, bringing face painting, crafts, story-reading, and cheerful comfort during difficult treatments.

features.title: Latidos Patient Management Platform
features.desc: Developed a full digital patient tracking database for Fundación Latidos. Modernized 717+ patient records, tracking 573 living beneficiaries and 268 patients on surgery waiting lists.

features.title: Pediatric Medical Supply Fundraising
features.desc: Raising funds for essential diagnostic tools, medicines, and surgical preparation items for pediatric cardiac patients — with an active online campaign underway.

grow.title: Grow: Optimizing Spaces Where Children Heal & Learn
grow.subtitle: BioRhythm environmental research investigating chemical air quality, noise, illumination, and micro-climates in healing spaces.
grow.desc: Where a child learns or recovers deeply shapes their ability to focus and heal. We research both chemical and physical environmental parameters — from CO₂ concentration and volatile organic compounds to noise and lighting — and propose practical, low-cost interventions.

features.title: Indoor Air Chemistry (CO₂, VOC, PM2.5)
features.desc: Measuring carbon dioxide concentration (ppm), volatile organic compounds from cleaning agents and medical materials, and fine particulate matter in pediatric wards to quantify chemical exposure and ventilation adequacy.

features.title: Sound Level Monitoring (dB)
features.desc: Measuring ambient noise levels in high-traffic hospital corridors and classrooms to design sound-dampening layouts and quiet corners.

features.title: Lighting & Glare Assessment (Lux)
features.desc: Studying natural and artificial light exposure to prevent visual fatigue, support sleep-wake cycles, and optimize concentration.

features.title: Practical Environmental Guidelines
features.desc: Translating chemical and physical measurement data into actionable, affordable checklists for schools and care centers — covering ventilation improvement, chemical exposure reduction, sound dampening, and lighting optimization on minimal budgets.

cards.title: BioRhythm Field Research
cards.desc: Investigating physical recovery and learning environments in Panama healthcare and educational facilities through a systematic two-step methodology.

steps.label: Clinical Acoustic Survey
steps.detail: Sound level (dB) measurements in ICU and recovery wards to quantify stress and sleep disruption (Hospital del Niño).

steps.label: Illuminance & Microclimate
steps.detail: Measuring light levels (Lux), temperature, and humidity to develop low-cost spatial improvement checklists.

cards.tags: Hospital del Niño & Casita de Mausi · dB & Lux Field Data · Active Research

impact.systemsSubtitle: How we shifted from individual volunteer hours to building permanent systems adopted by established Panamanian institutions.

systems.title: Latidos Patient Management Platform
systems.problem: 700+ pediatric heart patient records were kept in paper binders with no automated search, risking delayed surgery follow-ups.
systems.solution: Architected a full digital registry tracking 573 living beneficiaries, 268 surgery waitlists, donations, and volunteer operations.
systems.validation: Officially presented and adopted at the Fundación Latidos Assembly (Sept 2026, Hotel RIU).

systems.title: National Math Platform & FGLG English Academy
systems.problem: Public school youth faced gaps in digital Spanish math tools and lacked conversational English practice for future opportunities.
systems.solution: Built a 35-unit gamified math curriculum (Pre-K to Grade 6) and distributed digital platforms and materials to 32 teachers, 20 elementary schools, and 23 NGO partners (including Fundación Latidos) to expand learning access for underserved students.
systems.validation: Official Certificates of Recognition awarded to all 5 Heartitude tutors by Fundación Gabriel Lewis Galindo.

systems.title: BioRhythm Environmental Studies
systems.problem: Excessive noise and harsh lighting in pediatric care rooms and classrooms elevate stress and slow recovery.
systems.solution: Field-deployed environmental measurement tools capturing noise (dB), lux, and climate to develop low-cost spatial improvement checklists.
systems.validation: Active research at Hospital del Niño and partner pediatric care centers.

impact.principlesIntro: Everything Heartitude does is rooted in values shared by educators and global frameworks (UN SDG 3 & 4).

principles.quote: Every child deserves an equal opportunity to learn — regardless of where they are born or the circumstances they face.
principles.note: We exist to close the gap between potential and opportunity.

principles.quote: Opening the door to education is not enough. The conditions inside must also be right.
principles.note: Through our BioRhythm research, we study and improve the physical conditions where children learn and heal.

principles.quote: No child should be left behind because of illness, poverty, or circumstance.
principles.source: Leave No One Behind · UN 2030 Agenda
principles.note: We show up consistently for children who need care and academic support the most.

impact.activitiesSubtitle: How independent study, direct engagement, and student-built systems grew into institutional partnerships and field research.

activities.title: Early Engagement with FGLG & Fundación Latidos
activities.desc: The relationships that would define Heartitude began here. Our team proactively approached Fundación Gabriel Lewis Galindo to address the lack of conversational English access for public school students — leading to site visits, Zoom sessions, and months of collaborative curriculum design. Separately, our founder independently studied Fundación Latidos, mapping their pediatric cardiac care model and identifying where student-led support could create lasting value. These weren't assigned partnerships — they were connections we sought out and built from scratch.

activities.title: Designing Math Tutoring with Fundación Latidos
activities.desc: Following months of independent research, we began formal discussions with Fundación Latidos to develop a structured math tutoring program for pediatric cardiac patients — children whose extended hospital stays had left them falling behind academically.

activities.title: Finalizing the FGLG English Program
activities.desc: Confirmed the online English conversation program structure with Fundación Gabriel Lewis Galindo — defining session formats, selecting 25 participating public school students, and assigning 5 Heartitude tutors across a 12-module curriculum.

activities.title: FGLG English Tutoring: 12 Sessions Delivered
activities.desc: Completed the full 12-session English conversation program with FGLG for 25 public school students — covering practical topics from daily routines and self-introduction to future aspirations. FGLG awarded certificates of recognition to all 5 Heartitude tutors.

activities.title: Math Learning Platform: Development Begins
activities.desc: Launched development of an interactive digital math platform aligned to Panama's national curriculum (Pre-K to Grade 6) — designed to fill the gap in Spanish-language educational technology for public school classrooms.

activities.title: Hospital Visits & Environmental Field Research
activities.desc: Began volunteer counseling sessions with pediatric cardiac patients at Hospital del Niño, while simultaneously launching BioRhythm — our environmental research initiative measuring noise (dB), illuminance (Lux), and micro-climate conditions in pediatric care spaces.

activities.title: Patient Records & Management Platform Development
activities.desc: Started organizing and digitizing years of accumulated patient records at Fundación Latidos — paper files tracking hundreds of pediatric cardiac cases. This process revealed the need for a comprehensive management platform, and development began immediately.

activities.title: Math Platform Complete: National Distribution
activities.desc: Completed the interactive math platform and began nationwide distribution — reaching 32 teachers, 20 elementary schools, and 23 NGOs across multiple provinces in Panama with free digital resources and printed curriculum materials.

activities.title: Latidos Patient Management Platform: Draft Complete
activities.desc: Completed the initial build of the Latidos Patient Management Platform with advisory input from Fundación Latidos and a pediatric physician at Hospital del Niño — a unified digital system tracking 717+ patient records, 573 living beneficiaries, 268 surgery waiting list entries, donation management, and volunteer coordination.

activities.title: Latidos Patient Platform: Institutional Adoption
activities.desc: Presented the completed patient registry at the Fundación Latidos Annual Assembly (Hotel RIU). The student-built system digitized 717+ paper records, now tracking 573 active beneficiaries and 268 children on surgical waiting lists. The platform was formally adopted by the foundation.

activities.title: Universidad de Panamá: Academic Co-Development
activities.desc: After reviewing our math platform, the Faculty of Educational Sciences (GIEM) at Universidad de Panamá initiated a co-development partnership — inviting our team into university classrooms to lead workshops alongside professors and pre-service teachers, co-designing instructional content and next-generation platform features.
